figures.Vis-fission: The book's homolysis and carbocation examples; Original figure archived as c12-chem-ch19-fig-fission (drawn for this lesson; not the textbook's picture).

findings: The book announces 'four' types of reaction and then describes seven; all seven are given.

The addition of HBr to propene is printed with the product CH3-CH2-CH2-Br; the main product is 2-bromopropane, as Quick Check 19.6 itself shows. The elimination product is labelled 'ethane' under ethene; read as ethene.
